title: Preserve normal nullable choice records in failed-merge recovery eligibility
acceptance: Why and actual root cause. Main87df introduced T269 contradiction checks using any(k in record for k in merge_keys) before nonmerge exclusion. Canonical board writer board/server.ts2672/2679 always writes binding:null and merge:null for ordinary answered choices. Actual D-firstmate-workflow-T259-2 kindchoice/purposerepin/chosenA with these null fields is refused unverified identity by stock MechanicalLoop.failed_card_evidence; private isolated omission of only null optional fields returns empty evidence/no hold. Production history untouched. Existing same condition affects T262/T264/T1001. Reproduce with full retained canonical nullable shape; no live event/decision edits.

Change. In both nonmerge record and retained decision_made event contradiction checks, distinguish canonical explicit JSON null optional merge metadata from substantive merge intent/outcome/binding. Missing or null merge/binding fields emitted by unchanged stock writer are not contradictions. Preserve refusal for purpose=merge, effect=merge and every non-null merge key including false, zero, empty string/list/dict malformed values, plus mismatched merge events. Do not use truthiness or broadly ignore nonmerge histories. Retain existing choice/kindless-purpose-dispatch exclusions and true merge identity/settlement/readiness/currenthead logic unchanged.

Caller inventory. Audit actual board decision writer2672-2680 and stock fm-decide choice serialization, fm-emit decision_made event payload, failed_card_evidence two scanners, advance scheduling, consumed-result migration and merge_turn. Production edits limited to fm_autopilot_loop predicate; board/server, merge helper, concurrent lock, binding/signatures/evidence format, pins and policies unchanged. If actual caller/fixture needs unlisted edit request exact amendment. Existing tests/lib/autopilot_loop.py current1200line helper has zero available growth; every owning-helper edit must remain within1200 lines; use existing scoped owning helper split only if complete explicit scope amendment needed, no oversize bypass. Add dedicated feature-owned tests/failure-replacement-null.test.sh and tests/lib/failure_replacement_null.py instead of growing any helper over1200 lines; wrapper declares literal production/fixture dependencies for fail-first selection and imports unchanged real owning fixtures. Existing owning tests modifications limited to mirror assertions required, no split-manifest change or shared fixture weakening. Shared merge_turn is fm_concurrent.py268, distinct from loop publication critical section; unchanged tests/concurrent-projects.test.sh and tests/run-project-turns.test.sh are mandatory full regressions.

Migration. All old choice/repin/dispatch records and signed failed-merge history remain byte-identical, no null stripping from stored data. Old snapshots finish unchanged; new frozen supervisor recognizes canonical null fields and resumes ordinary eligibility after normal reload draining live jobs. Valid historic failed-A replacement still requires fresh differenthead six gates/review/CI/current signed readiness/new captain answer. Samehead failure, forged/unknown identity, substantive contradictory fields/events and pending/success cards keep exact refusal. No retry of final failedA, approval carry or legacy evidence upgrade. Named dedicated migration cases must cover prior held ordinary-null history, already-consumed ordinary-null history, genuine failed history coexisting with null choices and live-job draining before new frozen supervisor eligibility. Compare all record/event/pin bytes unchanged; use dedicated scoped helper, no reload fixture edit.

Feature proof. Through actual production failed_card_evidence and advance/merge-turn fixtures, canonical answered choice/repin/dispatch records containing merge:null,binding:null no longer hold otherwise ordinary new-head PR; genuine failed merge plus canonical null nonmerge coexists and still verifies original signed settlement then fresh readiness. Include actual canonical nullable record writer-shape and actual stock decision_made event payload which omits optional null fields; separately labelled nullable compatibility payload must pass through unchanged fm-emit serialization; no arbitrary ignore-all fixture. Confirm old runtime fails exact nullable-choice eligibility assertion with complete test harness and test-only overlays; private mutation restoring presence-only predicate must fail the same assertion. Mere new command/import failure is not proof.

Complete negative matrix. For each record AND event merge key, missing/null are compatible and every representative non-null value remains contradiction: running/failed/merged, object binding, malformed empty/false/zero; purpose/effect merge regardless null fields refuses. Unlabeled kind with dispatch keeps compatibility only absent substantive merge evidence; wrong project/task/pr/id, false/forged readiness, missing/misordered settlement, identical duplicate valid settlements accepted with deduplicated timestamps and conflicting duplicate events refused (separate named assertions), same failed head, pendingcard, successfulcard and unknownhistory all existing assertions remain. Preserve timestamps precision and both nonmerge exemptions.

Preservation/privacy. Real disposable fixture history before/after comparisons prove bytes unchanged, no verdict fabricated; external private state remains private and wake only fixed bilingual categories. No copied real production details/organization identities in tracked test fixture; use neutral IDs/source-bound factual reproduction recipe. Canonical null shape is schema compatibility, not merge authorization. Existing format readers/pins remain unchanged and signed records retain authority boundaries.

Docs. Amend existing design/design.md §6 lifecycle/gates failed-card recovery contract in place to state normal null optional writer fields versus substantive contradiction, preserving §5.2 existing nullable writer contract. No tail sections, no broad architecture/role change. Other T269 firstmate skill statements remain accurate and unchanged.

Validation. Worker static-only, stock gpt6.1/Herdr, no production live edits. Independent firstmate declared setup FIRST and whole tests/autopilot-loop.test.sh/tests/autopilot-merge-path.test.sh plus unchanged decide,board-card-effects,autopilot,gate/evidence-binding consumers required; immutable actualcurrent CI and six gates/authenticated independent review/real mergecard. Exact SPEC and actual captain dispatchA before worker. Named historical/mutation assertions run separately from regressions; direct private root reproduction is attested, not authenticated execution or proof of all production cases. Execute the dedicated complete feature suite as well as named owners; wrapper and Python helper reached by stock suite discovery and explicit dependency selection. New feature test must exercise existing function on old runtime, not fail merely because new helper missing. Also run unchanged complete concurrent-projects and run-project-turns owning regressions; no production shared merge_turn edits. New dedicated Python helper must set os.environ[HERDR_ENV]=0 at module top before imports or card/crew-capable fixture bootstrap, and suppress bytecode mutation before immutable snapshots. Shell wrapper must set/export HERDR_ENV=0 before executing fixture activity and declare literal production/fixture dependencies. Reuse genuine owning fixture bootstrap without launching real crew/vendor; keep decide.test.sh source scanner unchanged and verify its complete owner. This is isolation of new scoped feature fixtures, not an exemption or permission bypass.
